workspace.description: The workspace whose GitHub installation reaches the repository, by the slug list_workspaces answered: required with repository; leave it out with agentId, whose agent settles it.

agentId.description: A coding agent whose repository the pull request is of, by its id as list_agents answered it, with number; leave it out to name the repository instead.

repository.description: The pull request's repository, as owner/name, one the workspace's GitHub installation reaches, with number; leave it out with agentId.

number.description: The pull request's number, in the repository that repository or agentId names. For an agent's own pull request, pass the number read_agent_changes answers.

part.description: What to read: overview (the default), checks, conversation, or changes.

path.description: With changes, one file by its path as files names it, to read its patch as well.

offset.description: With conversation or changes, the nextOffset an earlier read answered, to read the next page; leave it out for the first.
